risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, with clear discussion of revenue, earnings, margins, asset growth, accretion income, and expenses. Risk tone is cautiously positive, although margin compression, declining accretion income, acquisition integration, regulatory approval, and macroeconomic uncertainty present meaningful risks. Promotional language and standard forward-looking disclaimers modestly reduce transparency but do not appear strongly evasive.
